notes.title: Another fix and update for Dec 07 2024
notes.content:
I've finally had the time to do more fixes!  Again I need to apologize for the amount of down time that's happened with this app.  Unfortunately I've made no money from steam for 3 years now, and Twitch keeps changing their API which breaks the system.  Currently unemployed as well so I need to really focus on doing things to help me get a new job so I can eat and pay rent.  But enough dumping, I took a couple days to fix things up.

- The OBS websocket connection should work now, as well as adding and saving cameras
- Memory leaks fixed, should allow the app to run for an extended amount of time

Again if anyone sees any more bugs please let me know at support@streamertech.ca, I will try to address it if I'm not busy.  But please be patient.  I am not making any money so any time I put into this is just because I really appreciate that you all using and enjoying my idea.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Dec 05!
notes.content:
Recently it was brought to my attention that the chat commands stopped working (Thank you DJ Billy Lane).  In case there is any confusion, this app was not built by a team.  It was built by one highly motivated ex DJ with an idea, and I'm ecstatic every time I find out that anyone is using my app at all, let alone this long after the pandemic during which it was built.

Unfortunately Twitch keeps changing their API and breaking things!  I have not made a single dime from this app since the tail end of 2021, and I'm currently unemployed, along with various other real life problems, so I don't have time to check every feature in case Twitch has again decided to alter things.  However if anyone sees something broken PLEASE reach out to my support email (support@streamertech.ca) and let me know, and I'll try to address it if it's not too much work.  With that in mind here are the release notes.

1) The chat commands on twitch should work again, I don't know when this change happened but the chat message changed dramatically and I had to change the way it's parsed.

2) The OBS scene changing websocket plugin doesn't seem to work anymore, and I'm not sure why, but when I built this app OBS didn't have a built in websocket solution, and it looks like the plugin I built it for no longer works.  In order to fix this I would have to refactor the entire feature which would likely be at least a week of work.

If I can get the spare time and if enough of you are interested in the OBS websocket update I might try to find time, but at this exact moment I'm highly focused on finding a new job so I can pay my rent, and this app has never made enough to pay my rent.

But again, please do let me know if you find any other bugs.  I do not have the time to do any testing and I really do value anyone that sees the idea that came out of my brain and thinks it's something they want to use.

Thanks!
David
support@streamertech.ca

notes.title: Sync and Custom help web page update!
notes.content:
!Sync command is now active!  Your users can type !sync [username] and they can synchronize their dance, drink and speed.  Have your own music video dance troupe performing for your stream.

You also get to have your own customized help page on the streamertech website.  Seconds after you change your commands (skins, dances, etc..) your custom help page will update.   Further updates will give your users thumbnails for all the skins and dances so they know exactly which one is which.

Happy dancing everyone!

notes.title: New Features in Testing, Custom Help and Sync
notes.content:
[i]In case you've never tried to beta test on Steam, right click on the Streamer Dancefloor title in the library list and select "Properties".  In the properties dialog go to Betas and where it says "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" select "testing" [/i]

Two new features, ready to test for the summer feature release!   
1) Custom Help Webpage - I've setup the system so you get your own personalized help page on streamertech.ca.  Click on the "My Help" in the menu to see it.  Any changes you make to your enabled skins are reflected within a few seconds online.  This also means you can disable the help chat that sends messages to your chat room, lowering the amount of chat room clutter.  Notify your users about your custom url with the promo section in the app, or use any other system you already have setup. 

2) Sync/Unsync - By typing '!Sync [username]' your users can now synchronize their avatar with another user.   

If all goes well with testing I'll be releasing this to the default branch in 10 days.  If anyone notices any bugs or has a suggestion for how it could work better please send me an email. 

Thanks!
D
